definitions.explanation: A person who is not married. Gender-neutral — applies to both men and women.

examples.japanese: {独身者|どくしんしゃ}{向|む}けのマンションが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Apartments aimed at single people are increasing.

examples.japanese: {独身者|どくしんしゃ}の{割合|わりあい}は{年々|ねんねん}{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: The proportion of unmarried people is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: {独身者|どくしんしゃ}の{食生活|しょくせいかつ}は{栄養|えいよう}が{偏|かたよ}りがちだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that single people tend to have unbalanced diets.

notes:
A compound of {独身|どくしん} (single, unmarried) and {者|しゃ} (person). More formal than {独身|どくしん} alone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独身|どくしん} is the more common everyday word for 'single'
- {未婚|みこん} emphasizes 'never married' (vs. divorced or widowed)
- {独|ひと}り{身|み} means 'living alone' and may include divorced or widowed people

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}{向|む}け (aimed at singles)
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}の{増加|ぞうか} (increase in singles)
- {独身者|どくしんしゃ}{世帯|せたい} (single-person household)
